w:r.w:t: Employee Timesheet and Workforce Management System
The purpose of this Software Requirements Specification (SRS) is to define the functional and non-functional requirements of a web-based Employee Timesheet and Workforce Management System.

The proposed system will provide a centralized platform for managing employee information, recording working hours, monitoring timesheet submissions, assigning or managing salary-related information, and providing notifications for incomplete timesheet entries.
The system will also incorporate Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI capabilities, including an AI assistant chatbot, to assist users in accessing information and interacting with the system.
This document serves as a foundation for understanding the expected functionality, users, system components, technology requirements, and future development of the proposed application.

Managing employee working hours and related information manually can lead to incorrect data entry, missing timesheets, difficulty in monitoring employee submissions, and additional effort for managers and finance personnel.

The proposed system aims to provide a centralized web-based solution through which employee working hours can be recorded and monitored. The system will notify users who have not submitted their required timesheet information and provide authorized management personnel with appropriate access to employee data.
The system will also support salary-related information and use AI-based capabilities to improve the accessibility and usability of the application.
The major objectives of the system are:
To develop a centralized web-based platform for managing employee timesheet information.
To allow employees to record the amount of time they have worked through a structured timesheet.
To reduce incorrect or invalid hour entries through appropriate validation mechanisms.
To allow HR personnel to upload and manage employee-related data.
To provide managers and finance personnel with access to relevant employee and timesheet information according to their authorization level.
To provide directors with organization-wide visibility of employee information and timesheet data.
To automatically identify employees who have not submitted their required timesheet information and generate alerts or notifications.
To support salary-related information and its association with employee/work-hour data.
To integrate Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI capabilities into the application.
To provide an AI assistant chatbot that can help authorized users interact with and retrieve information from the system.

The proposed Employee Timesheet and Workforce Management System will provide a centralized platform for recording, monitoring, and managing employee working-hour information.

The system will provide different levels of access for employees, HR personnel, managers, finance personnel, and directors. It will also reduce incorrect timesheet entries and identify employees who have not submitted their required information through automated notifications.
The proposed React.js, TypeScript, SQL, and Python technology stack provides a foundation for developing the web application and integrating AI and Generative AI capabilities.

Since the current requirements were gathered from an initial stakeholder discussion, several business rules—particularly salary processing, timesheet approval, notification schedules, AI functionality, and external integrations—must be clarified before the requirements can be considered final.
